record.original_question: Suppose λ is singular of countable cofinality and GCH holds below λ in the sense that every θ < λ satisfies 2^θ = θ^+. Is it consistent that either \( inom{\lambda^+}{\lambda} 	o  inom{\lambda^+}{\lambda}^{1,1}_2\) or \( inom{2^\lambda}{\lambda} 	o  inom{2^\lambda}{\lambda}^{1,1}_2\) holds?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.7. Suppose λ > cf(λ) = ℵ0, and θ < λ ⇒ 2^θ = θ^+. Is it consistent that (λ^+ over λ) → (λ^+ over λ)^(1,1)_2 or (2^λ over λ) → (2^λ over λ)^(1,1)_2?
The specific cases of λ = µ^+ and λ = 2^µ are more interesting (see Problems 3.6 and 3.7). We phrase the conclusions of this theorem, with respect to these cases.

Corollary 4.3. Strong polarized relations for singular cardinals. ... The strong relation (µ^+ over µ) → (µ^+ over µ)^(1,1)_2 holds in V^P. (i) The strong relation (2^µ over µ) → (2^µ over µ)^(1,1)_2 holds in V^P.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in ZFC set theory. Recall the polarized partition arrow notation: for cardinals $\alpha \geq \beta$, the relation
$$\binom{\alpha}{\beta} \to \binom{\alpha}{\beta}^{1,1}_2$$
asserts that for every coloring $c : \alpha \times \beta \to 2$ there exist $A \subseteq \alpha$ with $|A| = \alpha$ and $B \subseteq \beta$ with $|B| = \beta$ such that $c$ is constant on $A \times B$.

Let $\lambda$ be a singular cardinal with $\operatorname{cf}(\lambda) = \aleph_0$, and assume that GCH holds below $\lambda$, i.e. $2^\theta = \theta^+$ for every cardinal $\theta < \lambda$.

Question: Is it consistent with ZFC that at least one of the following polarized partition relations holds?
$$\binom{\lambda^+}{\lambda} \to \binom{\lambda^+}{\lambda}^{1,1}_2, \qquad \binom{2^\lambda}{\lambda} \to \binom{2^\lambda}{\lambda}^{1,1}_2.$$
artifact.category_tag: polarized partition relations for singular cardinals
artifact.status_search_result: Search results show related consistency results on strong polarized partition relations at singular cardinals of countable cofinality (e.g. when 2^λ > λ^+, or for specific instances such as λ=μ^+ or λ=2^μ), but no source clearly resolves the specific conjunction "GCH below λ with cf(λ)=ℵ₀" together with one of the two stated polarized arrows. Status could not be conclusively verified.

status_evidence.title: A polarized partition relation and failure of GCH
status_evidence.snippet: For lambda strong limit singular failing GCH, a polarized partition theorem holds.
status_evidence.claim: Positive polarized relations are known when GCH fails at singular λ, leaving the GCH-below-λ case as the harder direction.

status_evidence.title: Forcing many positive polarized partition relations between a cardinal and its powerset
status_evidence.snippet: Forcing constructions giving positive polarized partition relations between κ and 2^κ.
status_evidence.claim: Related consistency results exist, but the specific λ singular of countable cofinality with GCH below λ case is not clearly settled.

status_evidence.title: Some Problems in Singular Cardinals Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of open problems on polarized partition relations at singular cardinals.
status_evidence.claim: The problem appears in surveys of open problems in singular cardinal combinatorics.
